craft_notes: Sthāyin: play-refrain (waves/flames/light: everything manifest = sport — the khecarī-joy of display). Rows: row 3 (mine-and-his→manifest only). Close: only (eva — the exclusion: ONLY manifests, no residue: display-refrain with p06's picture-play). Rejected: 'maya' theology — killed: manifest kept (vyabheditāḥ as manifestations); 'mine' possessive kept — mamāgata is the verse's own intimacy.

lines: Water's waves, flame-plays of fire, sun's light:
mine and Bhairava's — world-plays manifest only.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jalasyevormayo vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ | mamaiva bhairavasyaitā viśvabhaṅgyo vibheditāḥ

reads_against.argmap: How are the world-plays manifested? → As waves and flames and light, Bhairava's world-plays are only manifestations.
c1_essence: World-plays as waves and flames: Bhairava's manifest only.
